mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is a chilly 40 degrees, feeling like 33 with clear skies over the Verona Area High School. We also have a waxing crescent moon, and you can catch the ISS passing overhead at 6:32 PM tonight as it travels from the west over Mount Horeb toward the northeast near Madison.

The city has released important notices regarding the November General Election. Additionally, the Plan Commission is preparing to review development projects, including site plans for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park.
There are no events listed for the next 30 days, but we will be sure to keep you updated if new community activities are added to the schedule.
In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers responded to a situation at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where a man was arrested for an O W I offence.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy the Caramel Cashew flavor of the day at Culver's. The restaurant is currently open and serving customers until their closing time at 10:30 PM tonight.
